name: Nurul Fatin Amira Binti Mohd Riza
title: Data Engineer
tagline: Building reliable data pipelines — from contract to insight.
bio: I'm a Data Engineer working across modern and enterprise data platforms: Databricks and dbt for contract-driven transformation, IBM IIDR and Netezza for replication and warehousing, and Qlik, Tableau, and Power BI for delivery. My background in Intelligent Systems Engineering gives me a hands-on foundation in machine learning — I build data products that are correct, traceable, and useful.

seo.description: Data Engineer specialising in Databricks, dbt, data contracts (ODCS), IBM IIDR, Netezza, and BI tooling (Qlik, Tableau, Power BI). Based in Seremban, Malaysia.
